### get_notes

```python
project.get_notes(queryfilter: dict = None, sort: Optional[str] = None, max_results: Optional[int] = None) -> List[dict]
```

Retrieve the notes of the current project.

- `queryfilter`: Optional filter parameters (e.g. created_at, medium, person)
- `sort`: Optional order, e.g. '-created_at' for the newest note first (default: ascending by id)
- `max_results`: Return at most this many notes, fetching only the pages needed (default: all)
- Returns: List of notes

API: `GET /projects/{id}/notes`

### ProjectCategory

References of the project categories of new accounts. Project categories are defined per
account (GET /project_categories); a project with another category keeps its reference as text.
